# void

> void is a free, ephemeral peer-to-peer voice room application. Open a room with one click, share a short code with up to nine others, and talk — voice, chat, files, and screen sharing travel directly between participants over WebRTC, without servers, accounts, history, or tracking. When the last person leaves, the room disappears entirely.
